description: Test suite for UnauthorizedFloodGuard class and isUnauthorizedRoleError function, verifying their behavior in handling unauthorized responses and error detection.

classes.name: UnauthorizedFloodGuard
classes.description: A class responsible for managing and limiting counts of unauthorized responses, with capabilities to reset counters and determine if connection should close.

methods.name: registerUnauthorized
methods.description: Method of UnauthorizedFloodGuard that registers an unauthorized event, updating counters and returning flags indicating if connection should close or be logged.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Method of UnauthorizedFloodGuard that resets internal counters.

methods.name: isUnauthorizedRoleError
methods.description: Function that determines whether a given error shape indicates an unauthorized role error.

ctags.name: guard
ctags.pattern: /^    const guard = new UnauthorizedFloodGuard({ closeAfter: 10, logEvery: 50 });$/

ctags.name: guard
ctags.pattern: /^    const guard = new UnauthorizedFloodGuard({ closeAfter: 2, logEvery: 3 });$/
